Work Hours Return Thursday Night — Bring Your Work, Leave With It Done

Thursday, November 5, 6:00–7:00 PM ET. Skool Work Hours are back tomorrow night in The Glam Vault — a full hour to work side by side, ask the question you have been sitting on, and move one real thing forward.

Work Hours are not a lesson to watch. Every Tuesday and Thursday from 6:00 to 7:00 PM ET, Vault members gather on Zoom to actually do the thing. Bring whatever is open on your desk: a post that is half-written, a product page that needs a second pair of eyes, a tool you started and never finished. Work Hours is where stuck turns into shipped, because you are not building alone.

The Zoom link lives inside the Vault, as always. Show up at 6:00, bring your work, and leave at 7:00 with something further along than when you sat down.
